title: Acne & Pimples
description: Active breakouts, comedones, and inflamed pimples caused by excess sebum and bacteria.

title: Post Acne Marks
description: Red or dark post-inflammatory erythema (PIE) left after blemishes heal.

title: Hyperpigmentation
description: Melasma patches and sun-induced dark pigmentation across cheeks and forehead.

title: Dark Spots
description: Localized age spots, sun spots, and concentrated melanin deposits.

title: Uneven Skin Tone
description: Patchy complexion, loss of radiance, and localized skin tone variations.

title: Dry Skin
description: Flakiness, rough surface texture, and lack of natural lubricating lipids.

title: Oily Skin
description: Midday facial shine, overactive sebum glands, and slick skin feel.

title: Sensitive Skin
description: Fragile moisture barrier, stinging reaction to skincare products, and easy irritation.

title: Redness
description: Facial flushing, reactive redness, and visible superficial capillaries.

title: Rosacea
description: Persistent central facial redness, flushing episodes, and delicate vascular sensitivity.

title: Fine Lines
description: Early expression lines around the eyes, forehead, and mouth.

title: Wrinkles
description: Deeper structural creases and loss of skin elasticity over time.

title: Enlarged Pores
description: Stretched pore openings around T-zone due to sebum congestion.

title: Dull Skin
description: Sluggish cellular turnover resulting in lack of glow and flat complexion.

title: Sun Damage
description: UV-induced photoaging, solar lentigines, and loss of collagen firmness.

title: Dehydration
description: Transepidermal water loss causing fine surface dehydration lines and tightness.
